name: sim-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the simulation verification for the checked-in buck-regulator example. Run `/sim:gates` on the workspace brief (or `python3 $SIM_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/sim_launcher.py gates examples/buck-regulator/buck.sim.json`), compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in the regenerated sim-report under out/buck_regulator/, and write a short result to records/.
